quotes.text: Commencement date 05 January 2025
Commencement Date the date stated in the Agreement on which the Subcontractor is to begin the Works.

discrepancies: Note only: the App A definition of Commencement Date is on p34, not on the cited p1; it states no date itself and refers back to 'the date stated in the Agreement' (p1 particulars).

quotes.text: Date for completion 27 September 2025
The Date for Completion stated in the Form of Subcontract is extended to 31 March 2026 (extension of time, 185 days).
The Date for Completion stated in the Form of Subcontract is extended to 30 September 2026 (second extension of time, 183 days).
The Contractor shall retain 5 per cent of the value of each valuation. Retention is calculated on the total of the application and not on individual items, and is rounded down to the nearest halala.
Retention 5 per cent of each valuation
No application shall be submitted before the last day of the period it states
An application shall be submitted within 21 days of the end of the period it covers.
Normal working hours are 06:00 to 18:00 on working days. Work executed between 18:00 and 06:00 is Night Work
Night Work work executed between 18:00 and 06:00.

discrepancies: Note only: the App A definition of Night Work cited in the note is on p34 (not a cited page); Cl.7 on p3 also states it.

quotes.text: The rest days under this Subcontract are Friday and Saturday.
Rest days Friday and Saturday
Rest day Friday and Saturday.

discrepancies: Note only: the App A definition of Rest day is on p34, not on the cited pages 1 or 3.

printed_value: once only, to the rate after the whole of the build-up described in Clause 27 has been completed, to the nearest halala, a half halala being rounded upward

quotes.text: Rounding shall be applied once only, to the rate after the whole of the build-up described in Clause 27 has been completed, to the nearest halala, a half halala being rounded upward. Rates shall not be rounded at intermediate steps.

printed_value: rounded to the nearest halala with a half rounded to the nearer even halala

quotes.text: the converted figure is rounded to the nearest halala with a half rounded to the nearer even halala. The conversion is made before any factor or uplift is applied.
and rounded to the nearest halala with a half rounded to the nearer even halala. That figure is then treated as the rate for the purposes of Clause 27, and Clause 28 applies to the build-up as usual.

printed_value: the first hour of that attendance (the quantity measured is one hour fewer)

quotes.text: Where an item is measured by the hour, a Chargeable Hour is an hour of attendance other than the first hour of that attendance. The site record states the hours attended; the quantity measured is one hour fewer.

Where an item is measured against a joint survey, a measured quantity not exceeding the surveyed quantity by more than 2 per cent is payable as measured. A measured quantity exceeding the surveyed quantity by more than that is payable at the surveyed quantity only.
A record that evidences a week records each day worked; a week is measurable only where the record shows work on not fewer than five days of that week.
A record covering a week records each day worked. A week is measurable only where the record shows work on not fewer than five days of that week (Clause 47A).

In any period of extension of time granted by an Amendment, that is to say for work executed after 27 September 2025, the ground classification is taken as G2 Firm Sabkha whatever the Engineer recorded on the day.

discrepancies: Note only: Clause 27A is not subdivided (i)/(ii) in print; '27A(ii)' corresponds to its second sentence. The printed text names the classification 'G2 Firm Sabkha'.

quotes.text: The night-working uplift is not payable on an item priced at a zone factor exceeding 1.1, the allowance for working away from the compound being taken to include it.

discrepancies: Note only: Clause 27A is not subdivided (i)/(ii) in print; '27A(i)' corresponds to its first sentence. The threshold is strict ('exceeding 1.1'), so a factor of exactly 1.1 keeps the uplift.

quotes.text: Material shall be classified at the point of excavation and recorded on the daily excavation record. A classification not recorded on the day of excavation shall be taken to be G2 Firm Sabkha.
On the first Application for Payment submitted after the Date for Completion as extended, one half of the retention held on all earlier Applications is released, rounded down to the halala.

Work shall be suspended when rainfall exceeds 5 mm in any hour. A suspension shall be recorded on the meteorological record, and standby under item E.51.010 is measurable only for the hours so recorded.

discrepancies: Note only: the threshold is strict ('exceeds 5 mm in any hour').
